description: For a booking made in another conversation, or through another assistant: where it stands, by its Vuelo reference (VU-...) and the email or mobile it was booked with. Says booked, reserved, cancelled, cancellation_in_progress or not_booked, with the item, dates, number of travellers, amount, free cancellation date, the stay (hotel, area, stars, room, nights, what is included, any tax paid at the hotel, and a public page about the hotel), the date a reservation must be paid by, any requests with Vuelo's team, and its history oldest first (booked or reserved, cancellation_requested, cancelled, refund_sent, request_raised, team_replied, changed with what changed, request_resolved). It never gives names, dates of birth or the booking page: to give the traveller their page, use find_my_booking. If nothing matches, say the details did not match a booking and ask them to check the reference and the email or mobile; never say which was wrong. For a booking made in this conversation, use get_booking_status.

email.description: The email the traveller booked with.

mobile.description: Or the mobile on the booking, instead of the email.

name: get_booking
title: Where a Vuelo booking stands
